description.value: Kazumi is a Japanese and Korean fusion restaurant in Langford, offering an extensive menu that spans hand-crafted sushi rolls, sashimi, aburi nigiri, donburi, noodles, hot pot, and Korean dishes like BBQ kalbi. The kitchen emphasizes fresh, quality ingredients sourced internationally, with eye-catching specialty rolls like the Lobster Roll and Volcano Roll. It makes a well-rounded meal stop for cyclists exploring the western Greater Victoria region.
